A Treatise on the Abyss.name: A Treatise on the Abyss
A Treatise on the Abyss.description: A Treatise on the Abyss. A nondescript black book. An in-depth, largely theoretical text describing the Roots, as well as information about the location of a nearby Gate.

Alchemical Limb.name: Alchemical Limb
Alchemical Limb.description: A mock firefly, baiting water carriers with its glowing lure. Take an Alchemical Limb (d8, petty when worn) to replace the one it tore off and an Oil Can (6 uses). The limb is immune to heat and poison. Needs to be oiled daily.

Alchemical Sigils.name: Alchemical Sigils
Alchemical Sigils.description: Your chest is lined with alchemical sigils, toughening the skin (1 Armor). Wearing other metallic armor nullifies the effect.

Alchemical Tattoo.name: Alchemical Tattoo
Alchemical Tattoo.description: Alchemical Tattoo A dog, cat, or bird that can leave your body on demand. It follows your commands to the best of its abilities and can pass its injuries (as STR loss) back onto you. Petty.

Always Pay Your Debts.name: Always Pay Your Debts
Always Pay Your Debts.description: Always pay your debts: You always repay what you owe, whether in coin or in kind. You expect nothing less from all others. Take a Blacked-Out Ledger, then roll a second time on the Bonds table.

Amadou.name: Amadou
Amadou.description: Amadou A vermilion fungus that catches fire quite easily. 3 uses.

Ancient Key (half).name: Ancient Key (half)
Ancient Key (half).description: You protect a long-dormant family secret. Take one half of an Ancient Key (petty). They say that if joined with its twin, it opens a Gate through any door.

Aqua Vita.name: Aqua Vita
Aqua Vita.description: Aqua Vita Purifies any liquid, converting it to pure water. Drinking it cures 1d6 STR (1 use).

Beast Aspect.name: Beast Aspect
Beast Aspect.description: That survival is all about adaptability. Once per day, you may take on a simple feature from a creature of your specialty (webbed fingers, night vision, etc.). Add a Fatigue each time.

Beast Omens.name: Beast Omens
Beast Omens.description: That the behavior of beasts is a language in itself. When observing beasts of your specialty you gain insight into weather patterns and impending disasters.

Beast Pathfinder.name: Beast Pathfinder
Beast Pathfinder.description: That the land is a language unto itself. Your chance of becoming lost in a terrain dominated by the beasts of your specialty is reduced by one step (e.g. 4-in-6 becomes 3-in-6).

Beauty Cream.name: Beauty Cream
Beauty Cream.description: After seducing a wealthy patron, their family hired a criminal gang to retrieve you. You got away and need to lay low. Start with Beauty Cream, 2 uses. Apply to appear irresistibly beautiful for the next 12 hours.

Bezoar Stone.name: Bezoar Stone
Bezoar Stone.description: An ill-tempered forest spirit cursed you for stealing, marking you as an enemy of their kind. Take a Bezoar Stone. Ingesting it cures any poison (1 use, unless retrieved).

Black Rose Fiddle.name: Black Rose Fiddle
Black Rose Fiddle.description: A Black Rose Fiddle (bulky). Its music causes intense sadness and immobility in nearby mortals. (Others are merely fascinated.) You don't know how to play.

Black Tar.name: Black Tar
Black Tar.description: Black Tar Versatile: both sticky and highly flammable. 3 uses.

Blacked-Out Ledger.name: Blacked-Out Ledger
Blacked-Out Ledger.description: Always pay your debts: You always repay what you owe, whether in coin or in kind. You expect nothing less from all others. Take a Blacked-Out Ledger, then roll a second time on the Bonds table.

Blacklegged Dandy.name: Blacklegged Dandy
Blacklegged Dandy.description: Blacklegged Dandy Hardy and adaptable. Tough or Perilous terrain are one step easier. 6 HP. +4 slots.

Blast Sphere.name: Blast Sphere
Blast Sphere.description: Blast Sphere A head-sized iron ball filled with explosive powder that detonates on impact (d12, blast, bulky, 1 use).

Blinding Powder.name: Blinding Powder
Blinding Powder.description: A guild warehouse. Take a Ladder (bulky, 3 m / 10 ft) and Blinding Powder (1 use).

Blood Pail.name: Blood Pail
Blood Pail.description: A Blood Pail (bulky) from a local death-cult. Empty it to raise a servant built from whatever is buried below, with 6 HP, 1 Armor, 13 STR, 11 DEX, 4 WIL, and shard fists (d8+d8). Only one servant can be raised at a time. If destroyed, you permanently lose 1d4 STR. Recharge: Fill with the blood of a dying warrior.

Blood-Red Flower.name: Blood-Red Flower
Blood-Red Flower.description: The Dawn Brigade did your family a service, giving you a dried Blood-Red Flower (petty) as proof. When the flower turns white, it means the favor is owed.

Bloodvine Whip.name: Bloodvine Whip
Bloodvine Whip.description: Bloodvine Whip d8 damage. On Critical Damage, it drains the target's blood, granting the weapon's next attack the blast quality

Blunderbuss.name: Blunderbuss
Blunderbuss.description: Your alchemical recipe worked, but a rival stole the blueprint before your claims could be proven. Take a prototype Blunderbuss (d12, blast, bulky) that takes one round to reload, and a taste for revenge.

TFBn50KLgZ5IcZ1S.name: Gold
TFBn50KLgZ5IcZ1S.description: A distant cousin left you a small inheritance. Take 20Gp and a Strange Compass (petty) that always points towards something deep in the Wood.

Bone Knife.name: Bone Knife
Bone Knife.description: An antlered, toothy demon that nearly ended you. Take a blood-stained Bone Knife (d6). On Critical Damage, its next attack becomes enhanced from contact with blood.

Book On Astronomy.name: Book On Astronomy
Book On Astronomy.description: Your debut composition reduced the audience to a gibbering mess, murmuring of bright creatures descending from the night sky. Later you noticed that the notes resembled stellar constellations. Take a Book On Astronomy, and a lot of questions.

Born to the Wild.name: Born to the Wild
Born to the Wild.description: Your family has a long tradition of serving, and you were trained from an early age on how to survive in the wild. When taking the Supply action, your yield increases by one step (e.g. 1d4 > 1d6).

Borrowed Senses.name: Borrowed Senses
Borrowed Senses.description: That there is far more to the world than meets the eye. With quiet concentration, you can borrow the senses of a nearby creature of your specialty.

Bouquet of Flowers.name: Bouquet of Flowers
Bouquet of Flowers.description: Your latest stunt destroyed a priceless artifact and injured a dozen bystanders. Start with a Captain's Uniform (petty), a Ceremonial Sword (harmless, 60gp), and a Bouquet of Flowers.

Bracelet.name: Bracelet
Bracelet.description: You promised a childhood friend that you'd bring them back a rare gift, something unique in all the world. Take a Bracelet (petty) woven from twine and wildflowers.

Breeze Knot.name: Breeze Knot
Breeze Knot.description: The Sylph and Her Lover. A bawdy tale of lost love. Start with a Breeze Knot (3 charges). Creates a strong breeze. Recharge: Tie it to a mast during a storm.

Briar Thorn.name: Briar Thorn
Briar Thorn.description: A Briar Thorn. It can pierce any organic material (quite painfully) but when removed leaves no trace of the intrusion.

Briarvine.name: Briarvine
Briarvine.description: Briarvine Entangles any creature up to horse size (STR to break free). Reusable.

Burial Wagon.name: Burial Wagon
Burial Wagon.description: A burial wagon (+6 slots, slow) from your last job. It came with a stubborn old donkey (+4 slots, only +2 slots if pulling wagon).

Captain's Uniform.name: Captain's Uniform
Captain's Uniform.description: Your latest stunt destroyed a priceless artifact and injured a dozen bystanders. Start with a Captain's Uniform (petty), a Ceremonial Sword (harmless, 60gp), and a Bouquet of Flowers.

Carrion Cat.name: Carrion Cat
Carrion Cat.description: Carrion Cat A clever pet, small enough to hide in your pack (bulky), but strong enough to scare off smaller predators. Requires one Ration a day, and it must be meat.

Catring.name: Catring
Catring.description: Catring 2 charges. Climb up walls and fall safely. Recharge: Place the ring on a stray cat's tail.

Celestial Lute.name: Celestial Lute
Celestial Lute.description: Harper's Devotion. A sad, short tale about a musician that falls in love with a star. Start with a Celestial Lute. Reveals the constellations above, no matter the weather.

Ceremonial Sword.name: Ceremonial Sword
Ceremonial Sword.description: Your latest stunt destroyed a priceless artifact and injured a dozen bystanders. Start with a Captain's Uniform (petty), a Ceremonial Sword (harmless, 60gp), and a Bouquet of Flowers.

Charity.name: Charity
Charity.description: Charity. Once per day you can shrug off a Fatigue. If your vow is ever broken, you permanently lose one inventory slot.

Cipher Stone.name: Cipher Stone
Cipher Stone.description: Cipher Stone A pair of sharp black stones. Each one decrypts any message written by the other.

Clatter Keeper.name: Clatter Keeper
Clatter Keeper.description: Clatter Keeper A hand-cranked device that emits a loud noise, frightening away most creatures.

Crow-Shaped Amulet.name: Crow-Shaped Amulet
Crow-Shaped Amulet.description: A crow-shaped amulet. You can ask a question of the dead but must add a Fatigue each time. They do not always speak truthfully.

Crowbar.name: Crowbar
Crowbar.description: Crowbar d6 damage. Sometimes you just need to get the damn thing open!

Cursed Sapphire.name: Cursed Sapphire
Cursed Sapphire.description: Cursed Sapphire Worth 200gp, it noticeably returns to your pocket shortly after you spend it. You can't seem to get rid of it.

Cusped Falchion.name: Cusped Falchion
Cusped Falchion.description: Crop thieves. Not all of them survived, but you were outnumbered. Start with +d4 HP and a Cusped Falchion (d8).

ytEX0QkKOAlA0l3l.name: Gold
ytEX0QkKOAlA0l3l.description: A noble's summer home. The place was full of fancy wine (+20gp) but not much else. Take Fence Cutters.

Death-Whistle.name: Death-Whistle
Death-Whistle.description: To the death, always: You never back down from a fight, no matter the odds. Take a Death-Whistle, 1 charge. Its scream frightens away all who hear it (save WIL or flee). Recharge: Capture the final breath of a dying warrior.

Delphinium.name: Delphinium
Delphinium.description: Delphinium Breathe water for up to one hour. 1 use, but can be divided into fractional doses.

Destrier Hooves.name: Destrier Hooves
Destrier Hooves.description: The Heavy Destrier's hooves (d10+d10), while you ride it.

Diseased Crop.name: Diseased Crop
Diseased Crop.description: The Withering, a type of stem rot from the Roots. Take a Diseased Crop (6 uses) that quickly decays any plant it touches.

Donkey.name: Donkey
Donkey.description: You scavenge raw tin and iron from battlefields, pulling teeth from still-twitching corpses. Start with a young Donkey (+4 slots, slow), a Crossbow (d8 damage, bulky), and a Saw (d6).

Dream Stone.name: Dream Stone
Dream Stone.description: Dream Stone A smooth blue stone that helps recall dreams more clearly. Overuse can cause dream-addiction.

Drowning Rod.name: Drowning Rod
Drowning Rod.description: Drowning Rod A finger-sized wooden stick that doubles in size each time it is fully submerged in water. It does not shrink down again.

Drowse Balm.name: Drowse Balm
Drowse Balm.description: Drowse Balm A wax bar. If boiled in water, the steam acts as a soporific agent.

Echo Leaf.name: Echo Leaf
Echo Leaf.description: Echo Leaf A blank parchment. Whomever unfurls it sees their actions of the day slowly revealed in a tight scrawl. Petty.

Enhanced Ears.name: Enhanced Ears
Enhanced Ears.description: Both ears have been surgically enhanced, tripling your hearing. You can focus on a specific sound, such as a conversation, at a great distance. You wear an ear flap to protect against sudden loud noises (WIL save to avoid temporary paralysis).

Everbloom Band.name: Everbloom Band
Everbloom Band.description: Everbloom Band A circlet adorned with flowers that never wilt. On Critical Damage, the flowers dissolve into dust, but you act as if your save succeeded (STR loss still occurs).

Everquill.name: Everquill
Everquill.description: Everquill A quill that writes on any surface. You still need ink. Petty.

Falconry.name: Falconry
Falconry.description: Falconry. You keep a falcon [3 hp, 5 STR, 16 DEX, 4 WIL, claws (d6+d6), bite (d8)]. It only eats live game.

False Cuffs.name: False Cuffs
False Cuffs.description: False Cuffs Comfortable, realistic-looking cuffs. Only you know the trick to get out of them.

False Prophet.name: False Prophet
False Prophet.description: You were a peddler of fake prophesies, but when one turned out to be true, it drew unwanted attention. Roll on the Omens table, but keep the result to yourself. Start with a concealable Knife (d6, petty).

Feather Quill.name: Feather Quill
Feather Quill.description: The Thrush and the Meadow. A moody tale told in alternating chorus. Start with a Feather Quill (1 use, petty). A map drawn with this quill reveals the most expedient course between any two points.

Fence Cutters.name: Fence Cutters
Fence Cutters.description: A noble's summer home. The place was full of fancy wine (+20gp) but not much else. Take Fence Cutters.

Fermented Spirits.name: Fermented Spirits
Fermented Spirits.description: Fermented Spirits Keeps you warm at the best of times and as an explosive at the worst. 3 Uses.

Fib Ink.name: Fib Ink
Fib Ink.description: Fib Ink Glows when used to write true statements but fades if used to write false ones.

Fire Eggs.name: Fire Eggs
Fire Eggs.description: Fire Eggs Six small pellets made of sea salt, wood, and crockery-dust. They explode at low heat (d8, blast) but the flames dissipate quickly.

Fireflask.name: Fireflask
Fireflask.description: Fireflask Highly alcoholic, yet strangely delicious. When thrown, it creates a wall of flames 3 m (10 ft) high that burns out after a few minutes. 1 use.

Fireseeds.name: Fireseeds
Fireseeds.description: A crop spirit, angered by a poor tithing. The fires consumed nearly everything, and afterward you were able to gather a pouch of Fireseeds (d8, blast, 4 uses).

Fireworks.name: Fireworks
Fireworks.description: Fireworks A dazzling albeit dangerous display. Enough explosive material to blow off a finger or three. 2 uses remain.

Gale Seed Extract.name: Gale Seed Extract
Gale Seed Extract.description: A voracious swarm of pests that swallowed crops and animals alike. With nothing to defend, you left. Take Gale Seed Extract (3 uses). Ingesting it lets you sprint with a speed four times your regular rate. Afterward you add two Fatigue.

Garden of Glass.name: Garden of Glass
Garden of Glass.description: Garden of Glass. Bound in the cover of another book. A heretical work, it describes the materials, procedures, and optimal locations required to open a Gate.

Ghost Violin.name: Ghost Violin
Ghost Violin.description: Ghost Violin A dark-gray violin that plays a haunting tune, mirrored by an invisible, distant twin.

Gildfinger.name: Gildfinger
Gildfinger.description: Gildfinger 1 charge. A finger glove that mimics any mundane key. Recharge: Bundle it with at least 100gp for a night.

Glamour Feather.name: Glamour Feather
Glamour Feather.description: Glamour Feather Plume of a firebird. Can make any creature appear convincingly as someone (or something) else. 1 use.

Glimpse Glass.name: Glimpse Glass
Glimpse Glass.description: Glimpse Glass 3 uses. A monocle that lets you see through walls or other obstructions. It shatters after the last use.

Glowsnail.name: Glowsnail
Glowsnail.description: Glowsnail Casts a soft, bioluminescent light. Feeds on one ration every two days.

Gnarled Staff.name: Gnarled Staff
Gnarled Staff.description: A druid, who taught you the language of trees. When it came time to , you took with you only a Gnarled Staff (d8) and left a promise that one day you would return.

Goat Powder.name: Goat Powder
Goat Powder.description: Goat Powder Derived from the placenta of a baby goat. Temporarily cures any affliction, but symptoms return within hours.

Gold Powder.name: Gold Powder
Gold Powder.description: You were adept at creating fake gold, which is almost as good. Eventually, your ruse was discovered, and you had to make a hasty retreat. Take a heavy Metal Ingot and Gold Powder (3 uses).

Goosefelt Tarp.name: Goosefelt Tarp
Goosefelt Tarp.description: Noble-born, you joined to escape family trouble. Take a Goosefelt Tarp (fits two) that you stole before leaving home.

Graftgrub.name: Graftgrub
Graftgrub.description: Graftgrub A small worm that can fuse inanimate objects with parts of the body. 1 use.

Green Skin.name: Green Skin
Green Skin.description: Your radical experiments turned your skin green, and you now gain nourishment as a plant. You don't need Rations, but a day without sufficient sunlight and water leaves you deprived.

Greenwhistle.name: Greenwhistle
Greenwhistle.description: Greenwhistle A small flute that calms plants, making passage through areas heavy with plant life a bit easier.

VRi1nw0gZ3roWWsj.name: Gold
VRi1nw0gZ3roWWsj.description: Your impressive corpseflower won a local contest then promptly killed a judge. You fled, but not without the Prize Money (100gp) and a warrant for your arrest.

Guide.name: Guide
Guide.description: Guide You shepherd caravans and travelers across water-soaked lands. Start a map (petty) relevant to your next journey.

Hardening Glue.name: Hardening Glue
Hardening Glue.description: Hardening Glue Makes any flat material (cloth, leather, sand) as hard as stone. Expensive (20gp a bottle, 3 uses).

Hawthorn Seed.name: Hawthorn Seed
Hawthorn Seed.description: Hawthorn Seed An acorn from the other side, gathered on the spring equinox. When planted, it sprouts a luxurious shelter, collapsing at moonrise the next day. 1 use.

Healing Potion.name: Healing Potion
Healing Potion.description: You created a restorative tincture that also causes accidental infertility. Take a Healing Potion that completely restores STR. Only you know of its unintended side-effects.

Healing Unguent.name: Healing Unguent
Healing Unguent.description: A wizened apothecary, who taught you the healing arts but maintained a clinical detachment. Take a Healing Unguent (restores d4 STR, 1 use).

Heartseed.name: Heartseed
Heartseed.description: A malicious forest spirit that poisoned a homestead. You saved a Heartseed from the roots of a dying tree. (Plant it to create a new forest.) Also, take Iron Bracers (+1 Armor, bulky).

Heavy Destrier.name: Heavy Destrier
Heavy Destrier.description: Heavy Destrier A beast built for war, an imposing creature. 8 HP, 1 Armor, hooves (d10+d10), +2 slots.

Hedgewitch's Curse.name: Hedgewitch's Curse
Hedgewitch's Curse.description: You were cursed by a hedgewitch for fooling some innocent village folk. Magic acts unpredictably in your hands (WIL save to avoid disaster). If you are the target of magic, the same applies to its wielder.

Heirloom Amulet.name: Heirloom Amulet
Heirloom Amulet.description: Heirloom Amulet (petty, glows in the presence of magic)

Hellcap.name: Hellcap
Hellcap.description: Hellcap. Exposure to its aroma causes intense nausea and vomiting. Either way, it clears the room. Bottled (1 use).

Hex Stone.name: Hex Stone
Hex Stone.description: Hex Stone Gathered from a river that flows from the other side. Removed from its iron tin, it can absorb the effects of an active magical effect. If destroyed, the magic is released. 1 use.

Hired Protection.name: Hired Protection
Hired Protection.description: You offer protection as a service, quietly watching for threats as money exchanges hands. You start with +d4 HP, and carry a Long Sword (d10, bulky) and a Gambeson (+1 Armor).

Hollow Wolf.name: Hollow Wolf
Hollow Wolf.description: A hollow wolf that had been frightening travelers. You took pity on the half-starved creature and nursed it back to health. Now it is loyal to you unto death. It is also a great tunneler. 5 HP, 11 STR, 13 DEX, 8 WIL, teeth (d6).

Homunculus.name: Homunculus
Homunculus.description: Homunculus A miniature clay replica of yourself that follows your every command. It hates being enthralled to you and complains bitterly whenever possible. Any damage done to the homunculus is also done to you. 3 HP, 4 STR, 13 DEX, 5 WIL

Honesty.name: Honesty
Honesty.description: Honesty. Choose a weapon type (blunt, blade, etc). Attacks against you of this type are impaired. If your vow is broken, you lose d4 WIL.

Hook.name: Hook
Hook.description: One of your fingers has been swapped, the bone replaced by gold and iron. Take a Hook and a Screwdriver that can attach to the fingertip.

Hunting.name: Hunting
Hunting.description: Hunting. When taking the Supply action, your ability to secure Rations increases by one step (e.g. 1d4 becomes 1d6).

Impressive Pin.name: Impressive Pin
Impressive Pin.description: Impressive Pin A metal badge of honor from the Guard. It can open doors but leaves a trail. Petty.

Incense.name: Incense
Incense.description: Incense Perfect for rituals or to keep the flies at bay. Cools the blood.

Invisible Pet.name: Invisible Pet
Invisible Pet.description: You dematerialized a beloved pet. Now it follows you around, invisible but always present. Although it cannot interact with the physical realm, you are able to share its senses. (Add a Fatigue each time.) It follows basic commands.

Iron Bracers.name: Iron Bracers
Iron Bracers.description: A malicious forest spirit that poisoned a homestead. You saved a Heartseed from the roots of a dying tree. (Plant it to create a new forest.) Also, take Iron Bracers (+1 Armor, bulky).

Iron Rattle.name: Iron Rattle
Iron Rattle.description: Iron Rattle A noisemaker for distracting or scaring your quarry. Sounds convincingly like a snake.

Ivy Worm.name: Ivy Worm
Ivy Worm.description: Ivy Worm A green worm often mistaken for a weed. Swallowed whole, it absorbs any toxins or rot in the body before exiting through the usual way.

Journal.name: Journal
Journal.description: You inherited an old Journal, bound in bark. Each evening, its pages are filled with the events of the day, crassly written from the journal's perspective. The writing is crude but accurate.

XphAFeGeebG7fgTA.name: Gold
XphAFeGeebG7fgTA.description: You deal in home goods and tools, hawking your wares to townspeople across the lands. Take 20gp worth of items from the [gear](/second-edition/players-guide/marketplace#gear) table. You are fluent in the Traveler's Cant.

s4z2uvA45g65mNKC.name: Gold
s4z2uvA45g65mNKC.description: You build small contraptions for local guilds (and don't ask too many questions). Take an extra 40gp and a wanted poster with your face on it. Given time and materials, you can open almost any door or vault.

Key.name: Key
Key.description: As a convict, the Oath was simply a means of avoiding punishment. Take a set of Lockpicks and the Key (petty) to a safehouse.

Knife.name: Knife
Knife.description: You were a peddler of fake prophesies, but when one turned out to be true, it drew unwanted attention. Roll on the Omens table, but keep the result to yourself. Start with a concealable Knife (d6, petty).

Ladder.name: Ladder
Ladder.description: A guild warehouse. Take a Ladder (bulky, 3 m / 10 ft) and Blinding Powder (1 use).

Large Net.name: Large Net
Large Net.description: Canines Take a wreath of Wolfsbane and a Large Net. Effective against werewolves as well.

DbcvvfOSGpy7DrSX.name: Leather Jerkin
DbcvvfOSGpy7DrSX.description: An old hunter. You were both quite happy, until it all ended. Take a Weathered Longbow (d8, bulky) and a Leather Jerkin (1 Armor).

Letter of Fae Parentage.name: Letter of Fae Parentage
Letter of Fae Parentage.description: You received a Letter (petty) detailing incontrovertible proof that your true parentage is that of Fae nobility. The note also indicates a date and location where you are to meet the letter's author, deep in the the Wood.

Letter to the Lord of Winter.name: Letter to the Lord of Winter
Letter to the Lord of Winter.description: During your travels, you met a dying hunter who asked you to deliver a message to their loved ones. Take a Letter (petty), sealed with tree sap. It is addressed only to the Lord Of Winter.

Linden White.name: Linden White
Linden White.description: Linden White Highly trained and agile, it can perform intricate maneuvers in a time of need (no DEX save to flee). 4 HP. +3 slots.

Living Nightmare.name: Living Nightmare
Living Nightmare.description: A Living Nightmare that dwells within you but manifests whenever you are in danger. It has your same Attributes and HP and attacks with claws (d8+d8). It disappears on Critical Damage (take 1d4 WIL damage), re-appearing again on the next full moon.

SnMkFBcgfszJzjmf.name: Lockpicks
SnMkFBcgfszJzjmf.description: As a convict, the Oath was simply a means of avoiding punishment. Take a set of Lockpicks and the Key (petty) to a safehouse.

Lodestone.name: Lodestone
Lodestone.description: Lodestone Draws out dangerous elements from the body and acts as a powerful magnetic force.

Luxcompass.name: Luxcompass
Luxcompass.description: Luxcompass Hums softly as it moves closer to the Sun. Eventually the noise becomes unbearably loud.

Manacles.name: Manacles
Manacles.description: Manacles Though old, it's still effective even against the very strong. You don't have the key.

Map.name: Map
Map.description: Guide You shepherd caravans and travelers across water-soaked lands. Start a map (petty) relevant to your next journey.

Mapping Paper.name: Mapping Paper
Mapping Paper.description: You were in a dark place and decided that your life needed a little direction. You're still not so sure it was the right choice. Take an Oilskin Coat and Mapping Paper.

Master Tinker.name: Master Tinker
Master Tinker.description: You build small contraptions for local guilds (and don't ask too many questions). Take an extra 40gp and a wanted poster with your face on it. Given time and materials, you can open almost any door or vault.

Mercy.name: Mercy
Mercy.description: Mercy. Choose a weapon type (blunt, blade, etc). Attacks with this weapon are enhanced. If your vow is broken, you can never use that weapon type again.

Metal Arm.name: Metal Arm
Metal Arm.description: One arm is fully metal and comes off at the shoulder. It can be used as a weapon (d8, bulky when not attached) and can move independently if you are within sight of it.

Metal Foot.name: Metal Foot
Metal Foot.description: One foot is mostly metal (kick, d6), and you treat some Tough terrain as Easy. Carry a Oil Can (6 uses). Without a daily application, you are deprived and noisy.

Metal Ingot.name: Metal Ingot
Metal Ingot.description: You were adept at creating fake gold, which is almost as good. Eventually, your ruse was discovered, and you had to make a hasty retreat. Take a heavy Metal Ingot and Gold Powder (3 uses).

Milkflower.name: Milkflower
Milkflower.description: Milkflower A gentle stimulant. Chewing it makes you immune to panic for the next hour. 3 uses.

Mimic Stone.name: Mimic Stone
Mimic Stone.description: Mimic Stone Records a short phrase that can later be played back.

Miner's Grease.name: Miner's Grease
Miner's Grease.description: Miner's Grease Great for dislodging a gem, tool, or limb from a tight crack. Highly explosive. 3 uses.

Miniature Lute.name: Miniature Lute
Miniature Lute.description: An entertainer once visited your home, filling it with story and song. He left one day without a word, leaving behind only A Miniature Lute. Something rattles inside.

Miracle Oil.name: Miracle Oil
Miracle Oil.description: Miracle Oil A smelly, slippery concoction. 2 uses.

Mischievous Spirit.name: Mischievous Spirit
Mischievous Spirit.description: You consumed a Mischievous Spirit that wreaks havoc on your insides, demanding to be taken home, deep in the Wood. It occupies one slot but absorbs one Fatigue each day. It wants you alive (for now).

Monk's Habit.name: Monk's Habit
Monk's Habit.description: The monks of a secluded forest monastery. When their rules became too strict, and you snuck away. Take a Monk's Habit (warm, petty) and a Spellbook of Control Plants. Control Plants: Nearby plants and trees obey you and gain the ability to move at a slow pace. Leaves grow along the spine, and it smells faintly of decay.

Mortal Wound.name: Mortal Wound
Mortal Wound.description: A mortal wound from a freed revenant. You were healed, but the disfigurement has made you a pariah. You require neither air nor sustenance but are still subject to pain and death. Trapped between worlds, the dead see you as one of their own.

Murderous Truffle.name: Murderous Truffle
Murderous Truffle.description: Murderous Truffle. Pungent, highly toxic, and very rare (worth 50gp to assassins). Illegal pretty much everywhere. 1 use.

Mythos Mask.name: Mythos Mask
Mythos Mask.description: Mythos Mask A plaster mask that allows one to take on a monster's countenance. Once it comes off, add a Fatigue.

Nature's Alarm.name: Nature's Alarm
Nature's Alarm.description: That nature's symphony can be heard if you attune to its rhythm. When surrounded by creatures of your specialty, they can alert you to approaching danger before it arrives.

Necklace.name: Necklace
Necklace.description: You sell rare and quality items to monasteries and nobles alike. Take a Spyglass, a Necklace (petty) worth 20gp, and a Scroll of Mirrorwalk (petty).

Nightdust Powder.name: Nightdust Powder
Nightdust Powder.description: Nightdust Powder Made from the ritual burning of six owls. When tossed in the air, day turns to night for a short while. 2 uses.

Nightmare Claws.name: Nightmare Claws
Nightmare Claws.description: The Living Nightmare's claws (d8+d8), while it is manifest.

Oak Lord's Whistle.name: Oak Lord's Whistle
Oak Lord's Whistle.description: You carved a Whistle (petty) from an Oak Lord's branch. Your act did not go unnoticed. You cannot seem to rid yourself of the whistle either.

Oath Compass.name: Oath Compass
Oath Compass.description: Oath Compass Points not towards North, but instead to the nearest member of the Guard. It also lets you know when they're getting close.

Oft-mended Chain Mail.name: Oft-mended Chain Mail
Oft-mended Chain Mail.description: A gruff blacksmith from a sleepy river town. You were always kept at arm's length. Now the forge is cold, and you've moved on. Take a Smith's Apron (petty) and a set of Oft-mended Chain Mail (2 Armor, bulky).

Oilskin Coat.name: Oilskin Coat
Oilskin Coat.description: You were in a dark place and decided that your life needed a little direction. You're still not so sure it was the right choice. Take an Oilskin Coat and Mapping Paper.

Omen.name: Omen
Omen.description: An odd birthmark, a strange smell: somehow, the touch of elsewhere still lingers. Roll on the Omens table (even if you're not the youngest player), but keep the results private for now.

Order of the Glass Sigil.name: Order of the Glass Sigil
Order of the Glass Sigil.description: Order of the Glass Sigil. Take a short sword (d8) and chainmail (2 Armor, bulky). You have contacts in most towns (the more rural, the better) willing to provide aid, food, or even weapons.

Outnumbered.name: Outnumbered
Outnumbered.description: Crop thieves. Not all of them survived, but you were outnumbered. Start with +d4 HP and a Cusped Falchion (d8).

wLUKk5pxYpQLE3Fg.name: Gold
wLUKk5pxYpQLE3Fg.description: Revere the dead: Death is a journey we all take, and it deserves respect. Take an extra 30gp. You always place two gold pieces on the eyelids of a slain foe. Somehow, you always find the coin.

Pain Band.name: Pain Band
Pain Band.description: Pain Band Touch an injured creature to transfer their wounds to you. (Exchange their lost STR with your own.) Recharge: Wear the ring while in perfect health. You will lose 1 STR, permanently. Petty.

Pan Flute.name: Pan Flute
Pan Flute.description: Rodents Take a Pan Flute that emits a high-pitched sound that only rodents can hear. So long as you play, they will follow, even to their deaths.

Paper Legs.name: Paper Legs
Paper Legs.description: Paper legs. You are extremely light, and can fall a few stories without getting hurt. Try to avoid tearing them or getting them wet.

Paring Knife.name: Paring Knife
Paring Knife.description: An azure warbler. The gametes attract a sizeable profit, if properly extracted. You succeeded but left its nest to the wolves. Take a Paring Knife (d6), an extra 20gp, and a pang of regret.

Performance.name: Performance
Performance.description: Performance Performing at taverns always yields both room and board. Sometimes you even get tips! Start with an extra 10gp.

Piebald Cob.name: Piebald Cob
Piebald Cob.description: Piebald Cob Intelligent, it can understand simple commands and even has an instinct for danger. 6 HP. +4 slots.

Pipeweed.name: Pipeweed
Pipeweed.description: Pipeweed Your good luck charm. Conversations tend to flow more easily after a smoke. 6 uses.

Plague Doctor's Mask.name: Plague Doctor's Mask
Plague Doctor's Mask.description: A plague doctor's mask, after its owner succumbed to the disease that wiped out everyone you once knew. They should have kept it on.

Pneuma Pump.name: Pneuma Pump
Pneuma Pump.description: Pneuma Pump Portable iron lungs (bulky). Enables life-saving surgery or underwater breathing.

Poacher's Woe.name: Poacher's Woe
Poacher's Woe.description: Poacher's Woe Strongly-scented arrows (3 uses). The scent is powerful enough to track with ease.

Pocket Leyfinder.name: Pocket Leyfinder
Pocket Leyfinder.description: Order of the Crossroads. Take a Pocket Leyfinder. It points to nearby ley lines and other sources of arcane power. If you lose it, the punishment is death.

Pocket Theatre.name: Pocket Theatre
Pocket Theatre.description: Pocket Theatre A set of small puppets and a folding stage. Good for quick distractions.

Portrait.name: Portrait
Portrait.description: You carry a Portrait in a locket (petty) of a past love who disappeared into the Wood long ago. Somehow you know that they are still alive.

Predator Sense.name: Predator Sense
Predator Sense.description: That the pulse of the hunt is a powerful impulse. You have a sense for when predators, even those not of your specialty are near.

OI18ewoJJr8MkG4I.name: Gold
OI18ewoJJr8MkG4I.description: An azure warbler. The gametes attract a sizeable profit, if properly extracted. You succeeded but left its nest to the wolves. Take a Paring Knife (d6), an extra 20gp, and a pang of regret.

Pulley.name: Pulley
Pulley.description: Pulley Great for moving gravestones, rocks, or even bodies.

Pullstones.name: Pullstones
Pullstones.description: Pullstones Two jet-black stones. When separated, the stones will always roll toward one another.

Pyrophoric Gel.name: Pyrophoric Gel
Pyrophoric Gel.description: Pyrophoric Gel A sticky green fluid that catches fire when exposed to air, then burns for 8 hours. Cannot be extinguished (1 use).

Quell Stone.name: Quell Stone
Quell Stone.description: Order of the Silent Veil. Take a Quell Stone (2 uses) wrapped in burlap. Extinguishes any nearby flames once exposed to air.

Quick-Flame Rod.name: Quick-Flame Rod
Quick-Flame Rod.description: Arachnids Take a Quick-Flame Rod and an Oil Can (6 uses). It can destroy a large spider nest in seconds.

Quicksilver Chain.name: Quicksilver Chain
Quicksilver Chain.description: Order of Canaas. Once per day, you can change into a wolf. Take a Quicksilver Chain. Without it, you are unable to shift back.

Quicksilver.name: Quicksilver
Quicksilver.description: Quicksilver A stimulant. Go first in combat, and automatically pass any WIL saves for one hour. Addictive: Save STR or become deprived after 24 hours without it. 4 uses.

Rabbit Skull.name: Rabbit Skull
Rabbit Skull.description: Your respectable puppeteering skills were matched only by your mimicry. You were so good you were branded a witch (literally) and banished. Take an Uncanny Hand-Puppet and a Rabbit Skull (petty) that protects against charms.

Rabbit's Foot.name: Rabbit's Foot
Rabbit's Foot.description: Rabbit's Foot You were wearing it when they found you. They say it is the foot of she who left you and that it protects you from witch magic. Petty.

lkT31MQ2uGNxj9QQ.name: Rapier
lkT31MQ2uGNxj9QQ.description: Bodyguard You are a protector for those afraid to travel alone. Start with a Rapier (d8).

q8KGFMVCkf9CevmD.name: Rapier
q8KGFMVCkf9CevmD.description: Despite your training in the deadly arts, an actor died and you were blamed. Take a light-weight Rapier (d6) and a false identity.

Raven Familiar.name: Raven Familiar
Raven Familiar.description: A Raven Familiar [8 HP, 3 STR, 11 DEX, 13 WIL, beak, (d6)]. It speaks as an intelligent being and is entirely devoted to you.

Rebirth Ash.name: Rebirth Ash
Rebirth Ash.description: Rebirth Ash Remnants of a bark spirit. Sprinkle to reignite a fire that has died or return to life a creature that has died only moments before. 3 uses.

Rebreak Glass.name: Rebreak Glass
Rebreak Glass.description: Rebreak Glass A wine flute that can be broken multiple times, reforming after 24 hours. Makes a really loud noise.

Reed Whistle.name: Reed Whistle
Reed Whistle.description: The Tinker's Two-Step. A humorous fairy tale about a gift-giving traveler. Start with a Reed Whistle. Anyone in earshot must pass a WIL save to perform an act of violence.

Regrowth Salve.name: Regrowth Salve
Regrowth Salve.description: Regrowth Salve Regrows a body part over the course of a day. 1 use.

Replacement Eye.name: Replacement Eye
Replacement Eye.description: You have a replacement eye that can magnify objects, act as a telescope, and provide minimal night vision. You cannot wear anything metal on your head, and the presence of strong magnets make you deprived.

Retractable Wires.name: Retractable Wires
Retractable Wires.description: A bank. (You were caught.) You bear a brand only visible by firelight, and anyone who sees the mark can ask you for a beer. Take Retractable Wires.

Revere the Dead.name: Revere the Dead
Revere the Dead.description: Revere the dead: Death is a journey we all take, and it deserves respect. Take an extra 30gp. You always place two gold pieces on the eyelids of a slain foe. Somehow, you always find the coin.

Reverse Teetotum.name: Reverse Teetotum
Reverse Teetotum.description: Reverse Teetotum 1 use. When spun, time skips backwards 30 seconds. Everyone remembers what happened.

U0Cx718fqe1Sf71L.name: Gold
U0Cx718fqe1Sf71L.description: Performance Performing at taverns always yields both room and board. Sometimes you even get tips! Start with an extra 10gp.

ebiYhTM4rcHkx5ZN.name: Gold
ebiYhTM4rcHkx5ZN.description: Wares You buy low and sell high, always making just enough to get by. Take a single item worth 20gp (or less) from the [gear](/second-edition/players-guide/marketplace#gear) table.

Rime Seed.name: Rime Seed
Rime Seed.description: An ice nettle, trapping and draining sheep. You lost your commission when the fungus you introduced killed half the flock. Take a Rime Seed (1 use). It freezes any body of water, no matter the size. Don't eat it.

River Twine.name: River Twine
River Twine.description: The Reed Fisher. A celebrated song about a massive carp that always seems to get away. Begin with a spool of River Twine (5 uses). Each dip into the river guarantees a catch, though it might not be pleasant.

Rivertooth.name: Rivertooth
Rivertooth.description: Rivertooth Impressively strong, capable of carrying heavy loads. 4 HP. +6 slots (only +2 slots if carrying two people).

Rolled-Up Map.name: Rolled-Up Map
Rolled-Up Map.description: A roaming storyteller once spun you tales of great treasure hidden deep in the Wood. You thought it naught but fancy, till they gave you A Rolled-Up Map (petty) marked with an X.

Root Tether.name: Root Tether
Root Tether.description: Root Tether When thrown, binds a creature as large as a wolf to the soil for a short time.

Rootflower.name: Rootflower
Rootflower.description: Rootflower. A white fungus found only on corpses deep underground. Ingest to restore d6 WIL. You will dream of the dead and their stories. 1 use.

Royal Crest.name: Royal Crest
Royal Crest.description: Royal Crest Born into royalty, you chose a different life. The crest grants you access but also alerts your family of your whereabouts. Petty.

Sailor's Friend.name: Sailor's Friend
Sailor's Friend.description: Sailor's Friend Over troubled waters and dangerous winds, you always make sure a ship reaches its destination. For you, passage is always free.

Sanguine Lens.name: Sanguine Lens
Sanguine Lens.description: Sanguine Lens Extracts blood from a target without their knowledge. A stolen drop placed on the eye reveals memories from the past day.

Saw.name: Saw
Saw.description: You scavenge raw tin and iron from battlefields, pulling teeth from still-twitching corpses. Start with a young Donkey (+4 slots, slow), a Crossbow (d8 damage, bulky), and a Saw (d6).

Scouting.name: Scouting
Scouting.description: Scouting. When taking the Travel action, your presence decreases the chance of getting lost by one step (e.g. 4-in-6 becomes 3-in-6).

Screwdriver.name: Screwdriver
Screwdriver.description: One of your fingers has been swapped, the bone replaced by gold and iron. Take a Hook and a Screwdriver that can attach to the fingertip.

Second Bond.name: Second Bond
Second Bond.description: A position of great honor, while it lasts: many guardians do not live out their natural lives. Roll a second time on the Bonds table.

Seed Bomb.name: Seed Bomb
Seed Bomb.description: Seed Bomb A canvas sack filled with seeds that explode on impact. d6 damage (blast, 3 uses).

Selflessness.name: Selflessness
Selflessness.description: Selflessness. You are immune to mind-altering magical effects, such as charm, hatred, frenzy, and so on. If you break this vow, you lose d6 WIL.

Sessile Oak.name: Sessile Oak
Sessile Oak.description: Sessile Oak (d8, bulky). Slams into targets. On Critical Damage something is torn off.

Shrieking Trumpet.name: Shrieking Trumpet
Shrieking Trumpet.description: Shrieking Trumpet. When exposed to light, it screams so loudly that all nearby attacks (including your own) are impaired. 2 uses.

Signet Ring.name: Signet Ring
Signet Ring.description: You owe a great debt to a member of the nobility and carry their Signet Ring (petty), which serves as proof of their protection as well as your obligation.

Silk Moth Shawl.name: Silk Moth Shawl
Silk Moth Shawl.description: Silk Moth Shawl A weatherproof blanket, it can also douse a fire without being damaged.

Silver Moss.name: Silver Moss
Silver Moss.description: You once freed a Naiad from a choked stream. In return, it gave you some Silver Moss (petty). Swallow it near water, and the creature will come, once, to repay its debt.

Single Gem.name: Single Gem
Single Gem.description: You inherited a Single Gem (500gp, cold and brittle) from a long-dead relative. It arrived with a warning: squander your newfound riches, and a debt long thought forgotten would be called in.

Sketchbook.name: Sketchbook
Sketchbook.description: Your life was saved by a member of the Marchguard, and you were inspired to join their ranks. Take a Snare Trap and a Sketchbook filled with detailed drawings.

Sloth-Tarp.name: Sloth-Tarp
Sloth-Tarp.description: Sloth-Tarp A tough and weatherproof fabric, useful for hanging off trees. When inside, you have +1 Armor.

Smelting Hammer.name: Smelting Hammer
Smelting Hammer.description: You were a military smelter, before peace destroyed your livelihood. Take a smelting hammer (d10, bulky) and a tin helm (+1 Armor). Given time and adequate materials, you can repair armor.

Smith's Apron.name: Smith's Apron
Smith's Apron.description: A gruff blacksmith from a sleepy river town. You were always kept at arm's length. Now the forge is cold, and you've moved on. Take a Smith's Apron (petty) and a set of Oft-mended Chain Mail (2 Armor, bulky).

Smoke Pellets.name: Smoke Pellets
Smoke Pellets.description: A university. You were seen but not pursued. You still don't know why. Take Smoke Pellets (3 uses).

Snare Trap.name: Snare Trap
Snare Trap.description: Your life was saved by a member of the Marchguard, and you were inspired to join their ranks. Take a Snare Trap and a Sketchbook filled with detailed drawings.

Soporific Concoction.name: Soporific Concoction
Soporific Concoction.description: A close friend disappeared into the forest. Now you see their face in any tea you brew. Take a Soporific Concoction (3 uses).

Soporific Darts.name: Soporific Darts
Soporific Darts.description: Soporific Darts (STR save or fall asleep, 6 uses)

Spark Dust.name: Spark Dust
Spark Dust.description: Spark Dust Ignites easily and quickly. Useful for starting a fire or as an incendiary device (3 uses).

Spike and Cord.name: Spike and Cord
Spike and Cord.description: Spike and Cord For traversing difficult terrain or for creating makeshift traps and structures.

Spiked Boots (d8).name: Spiked Boots (d8)
Spiked Boots (d8).description: Spiked Boots Cracks heads (d8) as easily as it does ice and muck. Travel is also a bit slower, but easier.

Sponge.name: Sponge
Sponge.description: Sponge Supposedly made from the remains of a rare sea creature. It never seems to dry out.

Sproutcup.name: Sproutcup
Sproutcup.description: Sproutcup. Ingest to shrink down to the size of a mouse. (Your belongings stay the same size.) You return to normal size within the hour, often in fits and starts. 1 use.

Stage Mail.name: Stage Mail
Stage Mail.description: You were scarred in an on-stage accident. The crowd cheered, thinking it was part of the act. Take well-worn Stage Mail (1 Armor), a memorable scar, and a fear of applause.

Star-Iron Mace.name: Star-Iron Mace
Star-Iron Mace.description: Order of the Bleeding Star. Take a Star-Iron Mace (d8). It shines faintly in darkness and becomes very hot in the presence of witchcraft.

Steadymade Buckler.name: Steadymade Buckler
Steadymade Buckler.description: No innocent blood: No bystander will come to harm on your watch. Take a Steadymade Buckler (+1 Armor). While holding this shield, you cannot be moved so long as both feet are planted on firm ground.

Stink Jar.name: Stink Jar
Stink Jar.description: Stink Jar Shattering this jar releases an odor so foul all nearby must make a STR save or immediately vomit. 1 use.

Stone Flute.name: Stone Flute
Stone Flute.description: Song of the Silver Stream. A wordless lullaby that mimics flowing water. Take a Stone Flute that can calm almost any river.

Stone Heart.name: Stone Heart
Stone Heart.description: You crossed a creature of the Wood, and it cursed you with a Stone Heart. With each passing month, the stone grows heavier by one slot. Until your debt is lifted, you cannot truly die.

Stone Pine.name: Stone Pine
Stone Pine.description: Stone Pine (d6, bulky). Produces one use of Sticky Sap per day. The sap is highly explosive.

Stonetree Sap.name: Stonetree Sap
Stonetree Sap.description: Stonetree Sap Sap obtained in exchange for blood. Hardens when rubbed on any surface (+1 Armor). 3 uses.

Storybook.name: Storybook
Storybook.description: A troupe of traveling entertainers. For a time, they were like family to you. One day you woke up and they were gone with no explanation. Take a Storybook, a Dagger (d6), and some burning questions.

Strange Compass.name: Strange Compass
Strange Compass.description: A distant cousin left you a small inheritance. Take 20Gp and a Strange Compass (petty) that always points towards something deep in the Wood.

Stray Fogger.name: Stray Fogger
Stray Fogger.description: Stray Fogger Wild but very fast (even in Tough terrain). Rides light. 4 HP. +2 slots.

Striped Bamboo.name: Striped Bamboo
Striped Bamboo.description: Striped Bamboo (d6). Collapsible, it only requires one slot (but still requires both hands).

Strong Silk Rope.name: Strong Silk Rope
Strong Silk Rope.description: Constable's quarters. You escaped but left some friends behind. Take Strong Silk Rope (9 m / 30 ft) and a queasy feeling.

Sun Stick.name: Sun Stick
Sun Stick.description: Sun Stick Provides ample warmth and light for up to one hour. Recharge: Leave in heavy sunlight for a full day. 1 use.

Surgeon's Soap.name: Surgeon's Soap
Surgeon's Soap.description: Surgeon's Soap A lye and ash block that makes skin temporarily transparent, revealing the anatomy within. 4 uses.

Sweetwhistle.name: Sweetwhistle
Sweetwhistle.description: Sweetwhistle 1 charge. Listeners hear a soft, familiar voice in the distance that they cannot resist following. Recharge: Lose a dear memory. (Describe it.)

Tacky Stalk.name: Tacky Stalk
Tacky Stalk.description: Tacky Stalk A woody reed that hardens into a permanent adhesive when chewed. 2 uses.

Tally Stick.name: Tally Stick
Tally Stick.description: Loyalty to the work: Your word is your bond. Once you've accepted a job, you see it through to the end. Take a weathered Tally Stick. Once a vow is marked onto its face, the stick hardens (d8) until it is complete. The stick will snap in half if the vow is ever broken.

The Cathedral and the Canopy.name: The Cathedral and the Canopy
The Cathedral and the Canopy.description: The Cathedral and the Canopy. Large-leaf binding over vellum. Nominally a children's storybook, the margins detail information about traveling, eating, and sleeping in the cloud forests.

The Silent Symphony.name: The Silent Symphony
The Silent Symphony.description: The Silent Symphony. Bound in fluorescent wrap. Very rare, it chronicles the subtle signs used by those employing invisibility magic.

The Star Waltz.name: The Star Waltz
The Star Waltz.description: The Star Waltz. A comet-shaped clasp bound in a fine leather cover. Detailed astronomical charts, celestial movements, and stellar festivals. Highly valued (100gp) for its usefulness to travelers.

The Wild Tongue.name: The Wild Tongue
The Wild Tongue.description: The Wild Tongue. A bundle of leather-bound scrolls. A seminal work, cataloging the hidden languages of beasts and how to understand them.

Thesaurus.name: Thesaurus
Thesaurus.description: You mocked a forgotten trickster god and were cursed for it. You speak only in perfect rhyme. Ironically, this has only made you more popular among your peers. Take a Thesaurus (20gp). Without it, you are deprived.

Throwing Knives.name: Throwing Knives
Throwing Knives.description: When your family lost everything, you took the Oath to avoid becoming a burden. Take extra Rations (3 uses) and a brace of Throwing Knives (d6).

Tin Helm.name: Tin Helm
Tin Helm.description: You were a military smelter, before peace destroyed your livelihood. Take a smelting hammer (d10, bulky) and a tin helm (+1 Armor). Given time and adequate materials, you can repair armor.

Tin of Snuff.name: Tin of Snuff
Tin of Snuff.description: There was an explosion, and you lost your sense of smell. Well, almost: you can sniff out gold as a pig does truffles. Take a Tin of Snuff (6 uses) to dampen the impact. Use it every day or become deprived.

Tinker's Paste.name: Tinker's Paste
Tinker's Paste.description: Tinker's Paste Seals shut any fist-sized opening. 3 uses.

Tiny Crystal Prism.name: Tiny Crystal Prism
Tiny Crystal Prism.description: You found a Tiny Crystal Prism (petty) buried in the dirt. When held up to the light, it shows visions of an unknown location deep within the Wood. Sometimes you feel a presence looking back at you.

Tooth.name: Tooth
Tooth.description: A silver marsh crawler that killed someone close to you. You now carry its Tooth (petty) on a chain around your neck as a warning to others of its kind. The tooth hums softly when something is stalking you.

Torch Fungus.name: Torch Fungus
Torch Fungus.description: Torch Fungus. When crushed, it creates a cold blue light for a short while. 2 uses.

Tournaments.name: Tournaments
Tournaments.description: Tournaments. Attacks with your bow are enhanced if the target is immobile.

Tragic Tales.name: Tragic Tales
Tragic Tales.description: Tragic Tales Banned in proper company, this book becomes less bawdy and more harrowing towards the end. Worth 100gp.

Trail Shaker.name: Trail Shaker
Trail Shaker.description: Trail Shaker A noisy instrument that reveals nearby trails, even when deeply hidden.

Training.name: Training
Training.description: Training. If you are the first to attack, melee attacks against you are impaired until you take STR damage.

Transport.name: Transport
Transport.description: Transport You deliver "delicate" packages throughout the lands. You have at least one contact in any major town.

Traveler's Cant.name: Traveler's Cant
Traveler's Cant.description: You deal in home goods and tools, hawking your wares to townspeople across the lands. Take 20gp worth of items from the [gear](/second-edition/players-guide/marketplace#gear) table. You are fluent in the Traveler's Cant.

True Name.name: True Name
True Name.description: A Fae creature's True Name. Use it to summon its owner for an act of great service, but only once. It could also fetch a hefty price, from the right buyer.

Truth Serum.name: Truth Serum
Truth Serum.description: You were exposed to a long-acting truth serum whose effects have yet to wear off. The disorder has its advantages: you cannot repeat lies you've heard, either.

Twig.name: Twig
Twig.description: A white crow appeared to you in a dream, holding a twig in its mouth. You awoke the next morning with the Twig (petty) in your hand. You believe it brings you luck. It smells faintly of sulfur.

Twine Bauble.name: Twine Bauble
Twine Bauble.description:
Twine Bauble (petty, Ward once per day)

Ward: A silver circle 15 m (50 ft) across appears on the ground. Choose one species that cannot cross it.

Uncanny Hand-Puppet.name: Uncanny Hand-Puppet
Uncanny Hand-Puppet.description: Your respectable puppeteering skills were matched only by your mimicry. You were so good you were branded a witch (literally) and banished. Take an Uncanny Hand-Puppet and a Rabbit Skull (petty) that protects against charms.

Universal Solvent.name: Universal Solvent
Universal Solvent.description: Ridiculed for discovering how to turn gold into lead, you were a laughing stock. Take a bottle of Universal Solvent (2 uses) that dissolves anything it touches into its constituent parts.

Vagrant's Veil.name: Vagrant's Veil
Vagrant's Veil.description: Vagrant's Veil 1 charge. Wear it to blend seamlessly into crowds, appearing as a simple pauper. Recharge: Donate the day's winnings to the poor. Petty

Valor.name: Valor
Valor.description: Valor. The first time you inflict Critical Damage, you receive +d4 HP, returning to the previous limit at the end of combat. If your vow is broken, you die.

Voidglass Shard.name: Voidglass Shard
Voidglass Shard.description: Order of the Blank Eye. Take a Voidglass Shard. Peer through it to see invisible marks, creatures, and other magical effects. Lose the use of your eye for an hour afterwards (you are deprived).

War.name: War
War.description: War. If you are first to attack, your bow gains the blast property for the first round.

Warble-Whistle.name: Warble-Whistle
Warble-Whistle.description: Birds Take a Warble-Whistle (3 charges). It can imitate any bird call and can even be used to send simple messages. Recharge: Feed a baby bird as its mother would, then blow.

Wares.name: Wares
Wares.description: Wares You buy low and sell high, always making just enough to get by. Take a single item worth 20gp (or less) from the [gear](/second-edition/players-guide/marketplace#gear) table.

Warming Stone.name: Warming Stone
Warming Stone.description: Serpents Take a Warming Stone that generates an irresistible heat and a vial of Antitoxin (2 uses).

Weathered Longbow.name: Weathered Longbow
Weathered Longbow.description: An old hunter. You were both quite happy, until it all ended. Take a Weathered Longbow (d8, bulky) and a Leather Jerkin (1 Armor).

Werewolf.name: Werewolf
Werewolf.description: Wolves, or so you thought. You are now a Werewolf [8 HP, 15 STR, 14 DEX, claws (d6+d6), bite (d8)]. Your WIL remains the same. You can turn at will (once per day) but must make a WIL save to revert. Anyone left alive from your attacks must make a WIL save to avoid infection.

Western Yew.name: Western Yew
Western Yew.description: Western Yew (d6, bulky). Can be wielded as a blunt weapon (d6). Noisy.

Whiskerwort.name: Whiskerwort
Whiskerwort.description: Felines Take a sack of Whiskerwort. Its odor can calm and control even the largest of cats.

Whisper Vial.name: Whisper Vial
Whisper Vial.description: Whisper Vial Whisper a message into the vial, and it will play it back to whoever opens it next.

White Ash.name: White Ash
White Ash.description: White Ash (d6, bulky). Can be used in place of a shield in melee combat (+1 Armor).

Wisp Lantern.name: Wisp Lantern
Wisp Lantern.description: Wisp Lantern Caged in wrought iron, provides a dim light so long as the wisp is able to feed on nearby pain and fear.

Wolfsbane.name: Wolfsbane
Wolfsbane.description: Canines Take a wreath of Wolfsbane and a Large Net. Effective against werewolves as well.

Woundwax.name: Woundwax
Woundwax.description: Woundwax Heals wounds from fire or chemicals (restoring full STR) but nothing else. 2 uses.

Wych Elm.name: Wych Elm
Wych Elm.description: Wych Elm (d6, bulky). Protects the bearer from poisons and toxins, so long as they are holding it.

Wyrmbone Whetstone.name: Wyrmbone Whetstone
Wyrmbone Whetstone.description: Revere the tools of death: Weapons are to be respected and maintained. Take a Wyrmbone Whetstone. Following a half-hour ritual sharpening, attacks with the weapon are enhanced until STR damage is dealt.
